guarantees: GET /v1/sync must only return published content and the caller's own private data
POST requires a validated per-user session; do not trust client-supplied user identifiers
Only moderators/admins can modify canonical bar records or sponsored promotions
Server must store mutationId per subject for idempotency and assign monotonically increasing revision
On baseVersion mismatch return conflict with current item and version; do not overwrite
Never expose testUsers, audit records or private files in public sync snapshots
Image upload is a separate authenticated R2 URL flow; not part of the JSON sync body
